title: Assessment Security
before:
Anonymous tip Line

Submit a Tip

Assessment security is essential for obtaining reliable and valid assessment data that supports informed decision-making and student outcomes in Maine schools. Accordingly, the Maine Department of Education takes appropriate measures to ensure the security and confidentiality of the state assessment materials. District Assessment Coordinators and School Assessment Coordinators are responsible for providing training to all personnel involved in assessment to ensure a common understanding of security and appropriate assessment practices.

notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.
Heading levels skip: jumps h1 to h3. Needs a person.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 5 headings sit at a level the page never opens — "Anonymous tip Line" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 7 links on this page open a file — 5 PDF, 2 Video — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Give the sub-headings their rule
decisions.why: 2 sub-headings are plain bold text. The design has a treatment for them — a teal rule down the left and a line across — and it had never been used on any page, because it needs a wrapper an author would have to know about.

decisions.label: Let a colon do its own work
decisions.why: A colon marks the words before it as a term and the words after it as what the term means. Here 2 list items open with a term set in the same weight as its own explanation, so the list cannot be scanned. No word changes and nothing is removed.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
